text:
jamie-cs: Heads up — Cloudline Labs asked for a temporary QPS increase for an APAC/EU demo tomorrow. They expect a short peak (~350 qps) during the live demo and then a sustained ~120 qps for ~48h. Also asking for CIDR allowlist on peered proxies. Renewal conversation happening next week so this is high priority. Can ENG/SRE approve?

nate-eng: We can do a provisional bump for 48h. Plan: route requests to dedicated-pool-d1 (reserved capacity), provision scale to 2x baseline, and add a rate-override flag with auto-revoke. Need the exact IP ranges and confirmation of regions (apac + eu). @rachel-sre can you handle the edge ACL?

taylor-cs: I just pinged the customer for the precise IPs, but they sent over two proxy ranges in the ticket: ```203.0.113.0/28\n198.51.100.32/28``` — they want ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-1 targeted. I'll confirm TTL for the auto-revoke (they asked for 48h).

rachel-sre: Those prefixes look fine. We'll apply the allowlist at the edge for the two regions and attach a short burst limiter. Suggest: burst window = 5m, sustained token bucket ~= 120 qps, peak gate at 350 qps. Also enforce TLS SNI and require customer to use the pinned model variant for the demo to avoid cold-start variability. I'll stage the ACL and add an alert to monitor latency.

ops-bot: ACL applied to ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-1 for Cloudline Labs (rule id: acl-cc-5941). Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-03-25T15:00Z. :white_check_mark:

nate-eng: I'll push the rate override now: set peak_qps=350, sustained_qps=120, window=1s, burst_window=5m, auto_revoke=2026-03-25T15:00Z. Config snippet for records: ```route: cloudline-demo\nregions: ["ap-southeast-1","eu-west-1"]\nrate_override: peak_qps:350, sustained_qps:120, auto_revoke:2026-03-25T15:00Z\ndedicated_pool: dedicated-pool-d1```

jamie-cs: Great — I'll notify the customer and set expectations (we'll monitor telemetry closely). Renewal flagged as at-risk in the CRM if demo fails, so please capture any post-demo notes. @taylor-cs can you add a short enablement checklist and CSAT prompt to the ticket?

taylor-cs: Yep. Creating support task #678901 with checklist: pre-demo connection test, token/latency sanity, fallbacks, and post-demo feedback form. Will add CSAT link and schedule a 30-min follow-up call next Tue. :memo:

rachel-sre: FYI — I'll add a temporary alert: infra.alerts/cloudline-demo-latency -> trigger when p50 > 350ms for 5m, and a KV cache hit-rate watch (if hit-rate < 40% revert to fallback model). If we see sustained tail latencies, we roll back the override.

nate-eng: Added alert rule infra.alerts/cloudline-demo-latency (id: ar-4429). Also wired a tracing span tag so we can correlate to their tenant id. :bell:

jamie-cs: Thank you all. Closing loop here — I'll update the ticket and ping if anything changes during the demo. If anything spikes unexpectedly, @rachel-sre and @nate-eng please coordinate rollback. :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-revoke check will run at 2026-03-25T15:00Z and notify #customer-success and #eng-sre channels before removal.
